caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, tan-colored ceramic vessel with a wide body that tapers slightly towards the top and bottom. The vessel has a rounded, slightly flared rim, and just below the rim, on opposite sides, there are two small protruding lugs or handles. The surface is smooth with subtle, horizontal lines indicating the handcrafted nature of the piece. The object is centered within a faint rectangular border on a cream-colored background. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Stoneware Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
